segments.text: Did you know there's an easy way to try the sales order agent on your own without complicated setup? In your Outlook account, create a separate folder for testing.
Then go to the email accounts page in Business Central and set up an account for yourself. Just pick the current user type.
Now go to the sales order configuration and skip to the very last page. You can select your own account
as well as the folder that you just created. Do not point the agent to your inbox. You only want your selected emails to be processed, not all of them.
Activate the agent and it will start monitoring that specific folder. You can use any old email for your test or choose a recent one.
Just copy it into the folder you created.

If you already have many pending tasks, which you don't need, you can stop them all with a single click. And here it is. The copied email has been picked up by the agent from your folder and can now be converted into a quote.
When you are done testing, you can easily switch the email account back to the shared company mailbox.
Folder selection is supported for shared mailboxes as well. So you remain in control of which emails are processed by the agent.
